summary: Run-owned asks and updates withdraw when their owning episode ends. Unowned decisions remain independent; authentic answers and source history are retained.

replay.detail: Retained owner-run fences apply to existing asks. Informational updates about terminal work leave attention without synthetic answers. The person-attention projection rebuilds its episode dependency edges.

compatibility.detail: New run-owned asks and updates capture the requester's owner run and generation. Ending or superseding that episode withdraws its unresolved attention. Cancellation no longer posts a replacement informational card; the requester still receives its cancellation message.

recovery.detail: Withdrawal, answers and configured deadline defaults retain their existing commands and behavior.
